name: Horticultural Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official current structure and available requirements. English numerical table explicitly 2026–27; confirm future-cycle thresholds. Admission model omitted because route not conclusively singular.

english.toefl: 2026–27 TierB: legacy speaking 22 reading 20 listening 15 writing 20; new speaking 4 reading 4 listening 3.5 writing 4
english.note: Published minimum table expressly applies 2026–27 only, future changes possible. Higher TA TierA: IELTS 7 overall/speaking 8; TOEFLspeaking 27 old/5.5 new with other minimums; otherwise language assessment/support. No DET/PTE/Essentials. Scores valid 2 years at deadline; field may restrict MyBest. Exemption: English first language plus qualifying citizenship/residency, qualifying US bachelor, qualifying bachelor from an English-official country with English instruction or 2 consecutive years of full-time work/study within the last 10 years in an eligible English-language country; physical presence and documentation conditions apply. Special exemption by approval.

applicationFee.note: Exceptional financial hardship considered for fully funded research degrees; international costs page explicitly offers route. Explain hardship in payment-page form after completing application, at least 3 business days before deadline. If denied pay fee; not guaranteed.

requirements.note: Strong life-science background essential; horticulture undergraduate major not required. Academic purpose, personal statement, transcripts, research/work experience and reference letters. Prior faculty discussion encouraged. Holistic committee review; assigned advisor named in offer.

funding.note: Every admitted PhD fully funded; assistantships/fellowships. No current amount or duration stated. Rolling admission offers mid-February–April 1 as packages developed.
